name: get_arrivals
title: Get arrivals
description: Show the next arrivals at one public transport stop in Switzerland, from now or from a given time. Returns for each the date and time, delay, line, final destination and platform. The stop can be a name or an ID from search_stops_by_name. If a name matches several stops (e.g. "Buchs"), the result lists the candidates with their IDs instead: ask which one is meant, or call again with the right ID. Arrivals show the vehicle's final destination, not where it comes from. For departures use get_departures. To check whether a vehicle stops at a certain station, or to get from A to B, use the connection tools. Times are local Swiss time (Europe/Zurich). Example: stop "Luzern", datetime "2026-11-26T18:00", transport_types ["train"].

datetime.description: Local Swiss time, ISO 8601 without offset, e.g. "2026-11-26T08:00". Default: now.

transport_types.description: Only use these means of transport, e.g. ["train"]. Default: all.

limit.description: Number of arrivals, 1–30. Default 10. A few more may follow if they arrive in the same minute as the last one.

name: get_connections_arriving
title: Connections arriving by
description: Plan public transport connections in Switzerland that arrive at or before a given time. Returns connections with date, departure and arrival times, platforms, delays, duration, number of transfers, and every leg with its line and the transfer time between legs. Stops can be names or IDs from search_stops_by_name. Pass place names as the user wrote them; do not add a canton or region yourself. If a name matches several stops, the result lists the candidates with their IDs instead: ask which one is meant, or call again with the right ID. To leave after a given time use get_connections_departing; to pass through certain stops use get_connections_via. Times are local Swiss time (Europe/Zurich). Example: from "Bern", to "Lausanne", datetime "2026-11-26T10:00".

from.description: Departure stop: name (e.g. "Zürich HB") or ID (e.g. "8503000").

datetime.description: Latest arrival, local Swiss time, ISO 8601 without offset, e.g. "2026-11-26T10:00".

transport_types.description: Only use these means of transport, e.g. ["train"]. Default: all.

min_transfer_minutes.description: Minimum time for each transfer in minutes, 0–60, e.g. 10 with heavy luggage. Connections with shorter transfers are left out. Default: the usual transfer times of the timetable.

name: get_connections_departing
title: Connections leaving after
description: Plan public transport connections in Switzerland that leave at or after a given time (default: now). Returns connections with date, departure and arrival times, platforms, delays, duration, number of transfers, and every leg with its line and the transfer time between legs. Stops can be names or IDs from search_stops_by_name. Pass place names as the user wrote them; do not add a canton or region yourself. If a name matches several stops, the result lists the candidates with their IDs instead: ask which one is meant, or call again with the right ID. To arrive by a given time use get_connections_arriving; to pass through certain stops use get_connections_via. Times are local Swiss time (Europe/Zurich). Example: from "Zürich HB", to "Bern", datetime "2026-11-26T08:00".

from.description: Departure stop: name (e.g. "Zürich HB") or ID (e.g. "8503000").

datetime.description: Local Swiss time, ISO 8601 without offset, e.g. "2026-11-26T08:00". Default: now.

transport_types.description: Only use these means of transport, e.g. ["train"]. Default: all.

min_transfer_minutes.description: Minimum time for each transfer in minutes, 0–60, e.g. 10 with heavy luggage. Connections with shorter transfers are left out. Default: the usual transfer times of the timetable.

name: get_connections_via
title: Connections via stops
description: Plan public transport connections in Switzerland that pass through one or two given stops, leaving after or arriving before a given time. Returns connections with date, departure and arrival times, platforms, delays, duration, number of transfers, and every leg with its line and the transfer time between legs. Stops can be names or IDs from search_stops_by_name. Pass place names as the user wrote them; do not add a canton or region yourself. If a name matches several stops, the result lists the candidates with their IDs instead: ask which one is meant, or call again with the right ID. Without via stops use get_connections_departing or get_connections_arriving. Times are local Swiss time (Europe/Zurich). Example: from "Zürich HB", to "Luzern", via ["Zug"].

from.description: Departure stop: name (e.g. "Zürich HB") or ID (e.g. "8503000").

via.description: 1 or 2 stops the connection must pass through, names or IDs, e.g. ["Olten"].

datetime.description: Local Swiss time, ISO 8601 without offset, e.g. "2026-11-26T08:00". Default: now.

time_is.description: "departure" (default): leave at or after datetime. "arrival": arrive at or before datetime.

transport_types.description: Only use these means of transport, e.g. ["train"]. Default: all.

min_transfer_minutes.description: Minimum time for each transfer in minutes, 0–60, e.g. 10 with heavy luggage. Connections with shorter transfers are left out. Default: the usual transfer times of the timetable.

title: Get departures
description: Show the next departures at one public transport stop in Switzerland, from now or from a given time. Returns for each the date and time, delay, line, final destination and platform. The stop can be a name or an ID from search_stops_by_name. If a name matches several stops (e.g. "Buchs"), the result lists the candidates with their IDs instead: ask which one is meant, or call again with the right ID. For arrivals use get_arrivals. To check whether a vehicle stops at a certain station, or to get from A to B, use the connection tools. Times are local Swiss time (Europe/Zurich). Example: stop "Bern", datetime "2026-11-26T08:00", transport_types ["train"].

datetime.description: Local Swiss time, ISO 8601 without offset, e.g. "2026-11-26T08:00". Default: now.

transport_types.description: Only use these means of transport, e.g. ["train"]. Default: all.

limit.description: Number of departures, 1–30. Default 10. A few more may follow if they leave in the same minute as the last one.

name: search_stops_by_name
title: Search stops by name
description: Find public transport stops in Switzerland by name. Returns stop IDs, names, the kind of stop (train, tram, bus …) and coordinates. Use it to turn a place name into a stop ID, or to see which stops a name could mean (e.g. "Buchs" matches Buchs AG, Buchs SG and others). For stops near a point, use search_stops_near. Example: query "Luzern" → 8505000 Luzern.

query.description: Stop or place name, e.g. "Zürich HB", "Genève", "Buchs".

name: search_stops_near
title: Search stops near a point
description: Find the public transport stops in Switzerland nearest to a coordinate. Returns stop IDs, names, the kind of stop, coordinates and the straight-line distance. Example: latitude 47.378177, longitude 8.540192 → 8503000 Zürich HB, 1 m.
